newsitem.title: USA: Universal Corp sees yr earnings above expectations.
newsitem.headline: Universal Corp sees yr earnings above expectations.

text.p: Universal Corp said earnings for its full year could be somewhat better than previous expectations of $2.40 per share.

It said its strong performance over the first half of fiscal year 1997 confirms its optimism about the earnings prospects for the full year and it anticipates further growth in earnings over the second half of the fiscal year.
The company noted that quarterly earnings comparisons continue to be complicated by abnormal crop conditions in the United States and the timing of shipments to customers.
Earlier the company reported that net income in the second quarter ended December 31, 1996 rose to $31.4 million or $0.90 per share compared to $27.4 million or $0.78 per share a year ago.
In October Universal said it expected earnings for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1997 would be generally in line with analysts's estimates of about $2.40 a share.
Universal reported net income of $72.3 million, or $2.06 a share, on sales of $3.57 billion for the year ended June 1996.
